packages/db/src/lonora_db/__init__.py.name: Database package

packages/db/src/lonora_db/account_author.name: Account authority records

packages/db/src/lonora_db/agent_state.py.name: Agent live state
packages/db/src/lonora_db/agent_state.py.description: Works out what an agent is doing now, from durable records only, for the live status.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/agents.py.name: Agents store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/agents.py.description: Creates, lists and updates agent records.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/app_opens.py.name: App opens store
